name: aave.borrow
description: Borrow variable-rate debt with explicit collateral/health bounds.

AccountingLocation.description: A link identifies principal flow; application-owned receipt verification proves its cash/position legs.

CostTreatment.description: Prevent a proved expense included in a repayment/supply debit being charged twice.

Quantity.description: Canonical arbitrary-precision unsigned atomic units, serialized as a string.

ResourceId.description: Resolved physical custody/signer identity, never merely a user-provided alias.

binding.description: Frozen exact execution fields and enforceable bounds, excluding observation times.

coverage: Rust implementation; synthetic and fixed-fork evidence recorded separately. Human/mainnet acceptance remains pending.
completion: Writes require canonical original transaction proof, confirmations, bounded actual gas, application-specific events and inclusion-block post-state.

semantics.amount: Exact decimal asset quantity; no floating-point conversion or rounding.
semantics.bounded_all: Supported cleanup operations require finite max_amount. Cash sweeps freeze observed units; full Aave repayment/withdrawal proves zero remaining scaled debt/claim. Every actual write receives a fresh preview and authorization.
semantics.deadline_example: Fixed schema illustration; replace with the current Unix timestamp plus 120 seconds before preview.
semantics.retry: Reconcile the original persisted hash, never blind replay.

name: binance.deposit
description: Send an exact finite native ETH amount from an enrolled Ethereum mainnet wallet to the current fixed Binance ETH deposit address; completion requires canonical chain proof and one usable matching Binance credit.
coverage: Broker-composite synthetic transport and canonical fake-EVM proof; production access and live funding acceptance are not verified.
completion: Original transaction identity is canonical and finalized, and exactly one current usable ETH deposit row plus matching Binance free-balance delta is observed.

semantics.amount: exact finite native ETH; amount=all is unsupported
semantics.completion: chain submission alone is insufficient; deposit history status 1 and usable balance delta are required
semantics.recipient: fixed from current protected Binance ETH deposit-address endpoint
